$comment: iPhone model identifiers (the hardware code that iOS gives, for example iPhone16,1) to the product name that people know (bipe ADR 0291, bipe-chat/bipe#1517). deviceRows shows the name when a device entry's model is a listed identifier, else the identifier as it is. The device entry keeps the identifier. Only iPhones that run the app's minimum iOS 18 (iPhone XS and later). Sources, checked 15 November 2026, both agree on every row: https://gist.github.com/adamawolf/3048717 and https://everymac.com/devices/by-identifier/all-iphone-model-identifiers.html. iPhone19,x is left out: the sources disagree on it. Names follow Apple's spelling (https://support.apple.com/en-us/108044).
